# Bundled third-party assets

andSri includes a deliberately small, offline subset of icons covering the target device and common applications. Unsupported applications use andSri's generated letter tile. The package-to-file maps in `app/src/main/assets/icons` document exactly which icons are bundled.

| Asset | Upstream revision/version | License |
|---|---|---|
| Lawnicons by Lawnchair and contributors | [`355609c`](https://github.com/LawnchairLauncher/lawnicons/tree/355609c68ebd035a69bf006d43edcb11b172d74c) | Apache-2.0 |
| Arcticons by the Arcticons Team and contributors | [`5176c57`](https://github.com/Arcticons-Team/Arcticons/tree/5176c57469022bd55331fd803e36ed8c0bc2f577) | Application GPL-3.0; icons CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Appstract by Melanie Gutzmann and contributors | [`4eb01d0`](https://github.com/yangchoo/Appstract/tree/4eb01d0c089f74b8bf42e284a78d73fe8ce7e5b4) | Apache-2.0 |
| Cuscon by MiepHD and contributors | [`c1722aa`](https://github.com/MiepHD/cuscon/tree/c1722aa8d36d4f703d341c87a55e99eb179ca869) | Icons CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 |
| Delta Icons by Leif Niemczik and contributors | [`8123f5e`](https://github.com/Delta-Icons/android/tree/8123f5ef34fd4f63063101bca86bcbfe62e2d523) | Icons CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 |
| Dollphone by Haruki Wakamatsu | [`69fa8fd`](https://gitlab.com/iSethh/dollphone/-/tree/69fa8fd4aa504201781b8fec768b7dd94790fa5f) | Apache-2.0 |
| Snow by baitmooth and contributors | [`edc2415`](https://github.com/baitmooth/snow/tree/edc24150a787c14e082e72f55bbce7dca6239cdd) | Application GPL-3.0; icons CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Atkinson Hyperlegible Next | [`7925f50`](https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next/tree/7925f50f649b3813257faf2f4c0b381011f434f1) | SIL OFL-1.1 |
| Newsreader | [`cfcb4f7`](https://github.com/productiontype/Newsreader/tree/cfcb4f7af0e52c25e8df2a2431814c8e5fe2e155) | SIL OFL-1.1 |
| Maple Mono | [`7.9`](https://github.com/subframe7536/maple-font/releases/tag/v7.9) | SIL OFL-1.1 |

The complete license texts are stored beside this file in `licenses/`. Attribution applies to each corresponding directory under `assets/icons`; upstream source names are retained in `mapping.tsv`. Snow SVGs were rasterized and may be tinted at runtime; color-pack raster assets are shipped unmodified. Adapted CC BY-SA artwork remains available under CC BY-SA 4.0.
